generationMethod: Built-in image_gen.imagegen tool; one new image per asset; no CLI/API fallback.
intendedUse: Illustrative product-category visuals for the EPP catalogue.
provenanceNote: AI-generated product illustrations in a photorealistic style. These are not photographs of Park Nonwoven manufactured products and do not establish product specifications, certification or medical claims.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: industrial EPP product catalogue photograph. Create one photorealistic studio photograph of a charcoal-black expanded polypropylene (EPP) protective helmet inner foam liner, shown by itself without the outer helmet shell. The object is an ergonomic hollow dome with a clearly visible curved inner head cavity, robust rounded perimeter, and a plausible series of elongated ventilation openings. Fine fused expanded-bead texture is visibly present on all foam surfaces: tiny irregular closed-cell beads, matte charcoal finish, no fuzzy open-cell sponge. Three-quarter slightly elevated viewpoint so the hollow liner shape and vents are immediately readable. Pale blue-grey seamless industrial studio background and ground plane, soft directional studio lighting, restrained natural contact shadow. Horizontal 3:2 composition, full object entirely in frame with generous clear margin, centered product occupying about 70 percent of the image. Premium realistic product photography, crisp material detail. No text, no logos, no people, no watermark, no certification marks, no claims of actual certification, no outer shell, no straps.

inspection.notes: Charcoal hollow vented helmet liner is fully visible, with fused-bead texture, no outer shell, text, people or certification marks.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: industrial foam product catalogue photograph. Subtle fine cellular bead texture on white foam surfaces and cut face, believable matte clean foam, no open-cell sponge, no wood core. Pale blue-grey seamless industrial studio backdrop, soft controlled light with delicate contact shadows. Horizontal 3:2 composition, both full objects entirely in frame with ample margins, no cropping. Premium realistic product photography. No ocean or surf action, no people, no text, no logos, no watermark, no certification marks. The blank and core sample are the sole subjects.

inspection.notes: Entire white surfboard blank and separate curved foam cross-section are visible in a neutral studio; no surf action, branding or text.

assets.prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: industrial foam component catalogue photograph. Pale blue-grey seamless industrial studio background and ground plane, soft directional light, realistic subtle contact shadows. Horizontal 3:2 composition, both objects entirely within the frame with generous margins, no cropping. Premium realistic product photography.
